headlines.description: — Klay Thompson scored all 23 of his points in the first half, including the 17,000th of his career, and six Mavericks scored in double figures in a 138-120 win over Utah on Saturday night as Dallas completed a two-game sweep of the Jazz.
headlines.shortLinkText: Thompson scores 23 points, including the 17,000th of his career, as Mavericks beat the Jazz 138-120

headlines.description: — Jaylen Brown scored 41 points, Sam Hauser led a 3-point barrage in the second quarter and the Boston Celtics blew away the Atlanta Hawks 132-106 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jaylen Brown scores 41 points and the Celtics blow out the Hawks 132-106

headlines.description: — Duncan Robinson and Cade Cunningham each scored 16 points in limited minutes as the Detroit Pistons routed the shorthanded Indiana Pacers 121-78 on Saturday night at Little Caesars Arena.
headlines.shortLinkText: Robinson and Cunningham lead Pistons to rout of shorthanded Pacers, 121-78

events.name: Phoenix Suns at New York Knicks

headlines.description: — Devin Booker scored 27 points after missing a game with a sprained left ankle, and the Phoenix Suns beat the slumping New York Knicks 106-99 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Booker returns from ankle injury to lead the Suns to a 106-99 victory over the slumping Knicks

events.name: Oklahoma City Thunder at Miami Heat

headlines.description: — Andrew Wiggins' 3-pointer with 31 seconds left put Miami up for good, Bam Adebayo scored 30 points with a career-best six 3s and the Heat defeated the NBA champion Oklahoma City Thunder 122-120 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bam Adebayo scores 30, Andrew Wiggins' late 3 lifts Heat past Thunder 122-120

events.name: Minnesota Timberwolves at San Antonio Spurs

headlines.description: — Victor Wembanyama had 39 points and nine rebounds, corralling a critical offensive rebound in the final seconds, enabling the San Antonio Spurs to fend off Anthony Edwards' season-high 55 points and beat the Minnesota Timberwolves 126-123 on...
headlines.shortLinkText: Wembanyama helps Spurs fend off season-high 55 points from Edwards as Spurs top Timberwolves

events.name: Charlotte Hornets at Golden State Warriors

headlines.description: — De’Anthony Melton scored 24 points as Golden State had eight players reach double figures in the Warriors’ 136-116 victory over the Charlotte Hornets on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Balanced scoring, 23 3-pointers lead Warriors over Hornets, 136-116

headlines.description: — Jamal Murray scored 42 points on 15-for-24 shooting and the Denver Nuggets pulled away in the final minutes for a 121-115 win over the Washington Wizards on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jamal Murray scores 42 points to lead Nuggets to victory over Wizards

events.name: Los Angeles Lakers at Portland Trail Blazers

headlines.description: — Shaedon Sharpe had 25 points to lead the Portland Trail Blazers to a 132-116 victory Saturday night over the Los Angeles Lakers, who were playing without top scorer Luka Doncic.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sharpe leads Blazers to 132-116 win over the Lakers, playing without Doncic
